info.title: Hotel Guest Assistant API
info.description: Multi-tenant hotel guest assistant. Guest API under /api/v1/hotels/{hotel_id}; legacy /api/* endpoints are deprecated.

get.description: Liveness: the process is up and serving requests. No dependency checks.

Readiness: can this instance usefully serve guests?

Required: the knowledge store and the conversation state store (Redis when STATE_BACKEND=redis).
The audit store is reported but not required: events are buffered and dropping them is logged. A reservation outage is reported as "degraded" but keeps the
instance in service: every replica shares the same PMS, so failing readiness would remove all of them
and stop FAQ answers that still work. The LLM is optional too (offline fallback exists).

503.description: not_ready: same body with status "not_ready" and the failing checks

get.description: Public, non-sensitive hotel profile for the guest UI (branding, languages, form limits).

409.description: CONVERSATION_BUSY: another turn on this conversation is in progress (Retry-After)
